headline: A 2013 executive order keeps a federal advisory council in operation instead of letting it expire.
what_it_does: Based on the title, this order extends the life of an existing federal advisory council so it can keep meeting and giving advice to the government. The title does not say which council it is or how long the extension lasts. No summary was provided, so other details are unknown.

who_it_affects.how: They can keep serving and meeting instead of having the council end.
They keep receiving the council's advice and recommendations.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 5, 2013; the exact effective date is not stated in the provided material.
